title: Operational Risk Analyst
summary: Operational risk analysts help a bank, NBFC, insurer or fintech spot and reduce losses from failed processes, people, systems or outside events. They run risk and control self-assessments, record loss events and near misses, test controls and track issues and key risk indicators for the operational risk manager.
dailyDuties: Collect and check operational loss events and near misses
Run RCSA workshops with operations and business teams
Test key controls and record evidence
Track issues and action plans with owners

skills.expectation: Run RCSAs, collect loss events and update KRIs
Test whether process controls work and record evidence
Rate process risks by impact and likelihood
Find the root cause of loss events and near misses
Maintain loss data, KRI trackers and issue logs
Know the RBI guidance on operational risk and resilience
Write clear findings and follow up with process owners
